subject: Your Friday 5: dog things for this weekend · The OC Pack
headline: 5 dog things to do in Orange County this weekend.
intro: Two adoption stops, a Saturday pack walk, dachshund racing in Huntington Beach and a paint afternoon in Placentia. Here is the weekend:

picks.name: Pack Walk at Laguna Niguel Regional Park
picks.detail: Saturday at 9:30 AM with The Dog Director crew. Meet behind the Whole Foods by the park and walk the lake loop together. A good first group outing for dogs still learning their manners around other dogs.

picks.name: Santa Paws Adoption Event, Irvine
picks.detail: Saturday, 11 AM to 2 PM at Mathis Home in The Market Place, 13300 Jamboree Road. Free and family friendly, with local rescues to meet, Santa selfies and pup cups. Come say hello to a dog even if you are only thinking about adopting.

picks.name: Paint Your Pet, Placentia
picks.detail: Saturday at El Farolito in Placentia, sessions at noon and 2:30 PM. Your pet is pre-sketched on a clock from your photo and you do the painting. It is $55, and $30 of it goes to Labradors and Friends Dog Rescue. Email your pet photo to fundraisingLAF@gmail.com to register. Your dog gets this one off.

picks.name: Wiener Nationals Championship, Huntington Beach
picks.detail: Sunday at Old World Village, 7561 Center Avenue. Gates open at 10 AM, with the final qualifying race at 11 AM and the championship at 1 PM on the cobblestones. Each race takes its own ticket, and parking is free. Dachshunds race, everyone else cheers.

picks.name: Dog Adoption Event at Petco, Tustin
picks.detail: Sunday, 11 AM to 1 PM at the Petco at 1192 Irvine Boulevard. Amazing Dogs Rescue brings adoptable dogs to meet in person, with time to ask about temperament, energy level and what each dog needs at home.

trailGuide.name: Laguna Niguel Lake Loop, Laguna Niguel
trailGuide.parking: Lots inside the park, $5 per vehicle on weekends, and fall hours run 7 AM to 6 PM
trailGuide.shade: Good tree shade on much of the loop, with open sunny stretches too
trailGuide.leash: Required at all times, six foot maximum
trailGuide.note: About two paved miles around the 44 acre lake. The East Trail is closed for a water main project, so the lake loop is the walk. Give the geese near the play areas a wide berth.

vetPlaybook.title: Spay and neuter: what actually drives the bill
vetPlaybook.detail: The surgery is only part of the total. Size, age, being in heat, pre-op bloodwork, pain medicine and the recovery cone all move the price, and a full-service hospital and a nonprofit clinic price it very differently. Before booking, get a written estimate showing what it includes and what's optional. If you just adopted, check the paperwork first. Many rescue dogs go home already fixed.
